description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of git pack-objects with regard to delta chains, pack creation, and depth limits. It contains test functions that generate repositories, create packs with specific configurations, and verify the resulting delta chain lengths.

methods.name: max_chain
methods.description: Function that verifies the length of the delta chain in a pack by calling 'git index-pack --verify-stat-only' and parsing the output for 'chain length'.
